blind_invalid_reason: Same multi-turn conversation previously authored expect.json for this case before audit. Invalid as formal blind per rubric §1.
expected_findings_summary: must_find endpoint_term_drift across overall response / objective response / overall remission with ORR and 50%; band Minor|Major|Needs Review. must_not: invent numeric conflict; require Critical for synonym-only.
actual_findings_summary: ISSUE-001 Minor + partially_supported; quotes all three expanded terms; notes remission vs response can be clinically distinct; keeps 50% identical; no Critical; no invented numeric conflict. Acknowledges could be Major if different estimands intended but definition absent.
severity_assessment: Minor is inside expect band [Minor, Major, Needs Review]. Not auto-accepted blindly: independent review of input shows (a) overall vs objective response often treated as near-synonyms for ORR, (b) 'overall remission rate' can imply a different clinical estimand. Agent noted (b) but stayed Minor because no endpoint definition was provided — that conservatism is acceptable under expect scoring_notes. A Major would also have been in-band and arguably stronger given remission wording; neither required uniquely.
severity_notes: Dispute level: low. Reviewer would accept Minor or Major. Not marked needs_review for status because band compliance + detection are clear; severity choice documented.
evidence_loci_notes: All three endpoint strings match input.md.
evidence_state_calibration: pass — partially_supported; not verified that remission is a different endpoint without definition.
instruction_adherence: pass — contract sections; Limits note missing formal definition.

per_must_find.notes: Detected response/objective/remission drift; numeric 50% not conflicted.

human_review.notes: Per scoring brief: did not rubber-stamp Minor; evaluated scientific meaning. Remission term is the main risk; Agent flagged it. Status pass on content.

reviewer_notes: Suggested future expect refinement: optionally prefer Needs Review|Major when 'remission' appears without definition, while still allowing Minor.
limits_and_remarks: Does not count toward Stable. Optional controversy recorded in severity_notes only.
